questions.stem: 過去，技職教育（vocational education）常被人看不起，導致許多有天分的學生不願意選擇這條路。
questions.answer: In the past, vocational education was often looked down on, causing many gifted students to be reluctant to choose this path.
accepted_answers: In the past, vocational education was often looked down upon, leading many talented students to be unwilling to take this path.
In the past, vocational education was often looked down on by society, making many gifted students unwilling to choose this route.

patterns: 被動語態（be looked down on）

questions.stem: 如今這種偏見已逐漸被打破，許多家長認為讓孩子及早學會一技之長是明智的。
questions.answer: Today, this prejudice has gradually been broken down, and many parents believe it is wise for children to acquire practical skills early.
accepted_answers: Nowadays, this prejudice has been gradually overcome, and many parents think it is wise to let their children learn practical skills early.
These days, this bias has slowly been broken down, and many parents feel that it is wise for kids to master a practical skill early on.

patterns: 虛主詞 It is + adj. + to V

1.explanation_zh: 「常被人看不起」用被動 was often looked down on（look down on 是片語動詞，被動時 on 不能省略）；說的是過去的情況，用過去式。「導致…」是前面整件事造成的結果，用句尾分詞片語 , causing／leading + 人 + to V（邏輯主詞是前面整件事）。「有天分的」用 gifted／talented，「不願意」用 be reluctant／unwilling to V。技職教育題目已附英文 vocational education。
evidence: 導致許多有天分的學生不願意選擇這條路
1.strategy_zh: 片語動詞改被動時，介系詞要留著（be looked down on）；「…，導致…」→ , causing + O + to V。
hints: 切成四段：（過去，）技職教育常被人看不起／導致／許多有天分的學生／不願意選擇這條路
標的詞彙：look down on（看不起）、gifted（有天分的）、reluctant（不情願的）、choose（選擇）、path（道路、出路）
句型框架：In the past, S + was often looked down on, causing + O + to be reluctant to + V …

2.explanation_zh: 「已逐漸被打破」偏見是被打破的一方，而且延續到現在，用完成式被動 has (gradually) been broken down／overcome。「讓孩子及早學會一技之長是明智的」動作當主詞太長，用虛主詞 it is wise for children to …（或 it is wise to let children …）；「一技之長」是實用技能 practical skills。兩個完整子句用 and 連接。
2.strategy_zh: 中文「做某事是…的」主詞很長時，英文先寫 It is + adj.，再接 (for 人) to V。
hints: 切成四段：如今這種偏見／已逐漸被打破／許多家長認為／讓孩子及早學會一技之長是明智的
標的詞彙：prejudice（偏見）、gradually（逐漸地）、break（打破）、parent（家長）、wise（明智的）、acquire（習得）、skill（技能）
句型框架：S + has (gradually) been p.p., and S + believe + it is + adj. + for + 人 + to + V …

references: In the past, vocational education was often looked down on, causing many gifted students to be reluctant to choose this path.
In the past, vocational education was often looked down upon, leading many talented students to be unwilling to take this path.
In the past, vocational education was often looked down on by society, making many gifted students unwilling to choose this route.

patterns.label_zh: 句尾分詞片語表結果（導致…）
patterns.frame: S + V …, causing/leading + O + to V …

patterns.label_zh: 被動語態（片語動詞的被動 be looked down on）

accepted: vocational education was often looked down on
vocational education was often looked down upon

common_errors.wrong: vocational education was often looked down
common_errors.right: vocational education was often looked down on
common_errors.explanation_zh: look down on 是片語動詞，改成被動時介系詞 on 不能省略：be looked down on。

common_errors.wrong: vocational education was often not looked up
common_errors.right: vocational education was often looked down on
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「看不起」是輕視，不是字面的「看不上去」；用 look down on。
前面是過去式 was，用 and 連接時要寫 caused；更簡潔的寫法是句尾分詞 causing。
逗號後直接接過去式動詞，會變成兩個動詞沒有連接；表結果用分詞 causing／leading，或寫 , which caused …。
修飾名詞要用形容詞 talented／gifted；talent 是名詞。

accepted: to be reluctant to choose this path
to be unwilling to take this path
to be reluctant to take this path

common_errors.wrong: to be reluctant choosing this path
common_errors.right: to be reluctant to choose this path
common_errors.explanation_zh: be reluctant 後面接不定詞 to V。
willing 後面要接 to V；「這條路」是比喻的出路，用 path／route。

traps.literal_error: In the past, vocational education was often not looked up, …
traps.explanation_zh: 「看不起」是輕視，用片語動詞 look down on，被動寫成 be looked down on；不要逐字翻成 not look up。

traps.literal_error: …, caused many gifted students to be reluctant to choose this path.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「導致」前面沒有主詞；英文逗號後直接接 caused 會變成兩個動詞沒有連接，要用分詞 causing（或 , which caused …）。

bonus.text: In the past, vocational education was widely looked down on, deterring many gifted students from pursuing this path.
bonus.explanation_zh: deter sb from V-ing（使人打消念頭）、pursue（追求）比 cause … to be reluctant 更精準。

1.restructuring_zh: 「被人看不起」不必譯出「人」，用被動 was looked down on；「導致…」不要另起子句寫 It caused …，改成句尾分詞 causing many gifted students to …。

references: Today, this prejudice has gradually been broken down, and many parents believe it is wise for children to acquire practical skills early.
Nowadays, this prejudice has been gradually overcome, and many parents think it is wise to let their children learn practical skills early.
These days, this bias has slowly been broken down, and many parents feel that it is wise for kids to master a practical skill early on.

patterns.label_zh: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞
patterns.frame: S + believe + it is + adj. + for + 人 + to + V …

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「偏見」用 prejudice／bias；partial view 是字面拼湊，不自然。
偏見是「被」打破，完成式被動要有 been：has been broken (down)。
被動要用過去分詞 broken；「已逐漸」延續到現在，用現在完成式。
many 後面接複數名詞 parents。
前後是兩個完整子句，只用逗號隔開會變成逗號接句，要加 and（或拆成兩句）。

parts.zh: 讓孩子及早學會一技之長是明智的
accepted: it is wise for children to acquire practical skills early
it is wise to let their children learn practical skills early
it is wise for kids to master a practical skill early on
it is wise for children to learn a practical skill early

common_errors.wrong: let children learn practical skills early is wise
common_errors.right: it is wise for children to acquire practical skills early
common_errors.explanation_zh: 原形動詞不能當主詞；用虛主詞 it is wise for/to …，或改成動名詞 letting children learn … is wise。

common_errors.wrong: it is wise for children learning practical skills early
common_errors.right: it is wise for children to acquire practical skills early
common_errors.explanation_zh: It is + 形容詞 + for 人 後面接不定詞 to V。

traps.literal_error: … it is wise for children to learn one skill's length early.
traps.explanation_zh: 「一技之長」是一項專長、實用的技能，用 practical skills／a useful skill；不要逐字拆開翻。

traps.literal_error: Today, this prejudice is gradually broke, and many parents …
traps.explanation_zh: 「已…被…」要同時表現完成式與被動：has (gradually) been broken down；broke 是過去式，不能當過去分詞。

bonus.text: Now that this prejudice has largely been dispelled, many parents consider it wise for their children to master a trade early.
bonus.explanation_zh: dispel（消除）偏見、consider it wise for … to …（虛受詞 it）、master a trade（學會一技之長）都更道地。

2.restructuring_zh: 「讓孩子及早學會一技之長是明智的」主詞是一整個動作，英文移到後面、用虛主詞 it 開頭：it is wise for children to acquire practical skills early；「讓孩子」可轉成 for children。

warnings: annotations.rubric.items.2.patterns[0]: gp-perfect-passive 通常對應句構 PERF（目前 code=PASS）

1.translation: In the past, vocational education was often looked down upon, making many talented students reluctant to choose this path.
1.explanation_zh: 「過去……常被人看不起」用過去式被動 was looked down upon；「導致……」是前一件事的結果，用句尾分詞 making + O + adj 表結果；「不願意」譯 reluctant to。

2.translation: Nowadays, this prejudice has gradually been broken down, and many parents believe it is wise to let their children learn a practical skill early on.
2.explanation_zh: 「已逐漸被打破」用現在完成式被動 has gradually been broken down；「認為……是明智的」用 believe (that) it is wise to 虛主詞；「一技之長」沒有固定英文對應，譯 a practical skill（也可 a specialized skill／a trade），「及早」譯 early on。

issues_zh: 第 2 部分「導致」只有一個字卻占 1 分，accepted 只收 causing／leading／making；學生寫同樣正確的「, which made／led many talented students…」或「so many talented students were unwilling…」會被扣分，等於只為句型給分，建議補進 which led/which made 等寫法，或把「導致」併進第 3、4 部分。
第 2 部分收 making，但第 4 部分的 accepted 多是 to be reluctant…；making 後面要接形容詞（making many talented students reluctant to choose this path），第 4 部分應補「reluctant to choose this path」，避免改卷時以為 making 搭 to be 才對。

problems: 第 1 題驗證者對4 部分切分有意見（warn）：第 2 部分「導致」只有一個字卻占 1 分，accepted 只收 causing／leading／making；學生寫同樣正確的「, which made／led many talented students…」或「so many tal

1.translation: In the past, vocational education was often looked down on, which made many talented students unwilling to choose this path.
1.explanation_zh: 「過去」配過去式；「看不起」用 look down on 的被動；「導致……不願意」用 which made + 受詞 + 形容詞（unwilling to），把結果接在前句後面；「有天分的」用 talented。

2.translation: Today, this prejudice has gradually been broken down, and many parents believe it is wise to let their children learn a marketable skill at an early age.
2.explanation_zh: 「如今……已逐漸被打破」用現在完成式被動加 gradually；「認為……是明智的」用 believe it is wise to 的虛主詞句型；「一技之長」譯成 a marketable skill（也可用 a trade）；「及早」用 at an early age。「一技之長」沒有唯一對應詞，所以信心為 medium。

issues_zh: 我的譯文是 …, which made many talented students unwilling to choose this path（非限定關係子句表結果），自然又正確；但第 2 部分「導致」的 accepted 只收 causing／leading／making 的分詞片語，中文沒有強制分詞構句，標的句型 PART 沒有被引出。建議 accepted 補上 which made／which led to，或移除 PART 標的。

problems: 第 1 題盲譯沒有用到標的句型 ['PART']：中文題目沒有自然引出這個句型（SPEC §5.7）
